title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women from Liguria and Veneto. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold each of them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Gabriella Gellio
tribute: Gabriella Gellio, 69, was a former primary-school teacher from Genoa who taught until her retirement. About fifteen years ago she moved with her husband to a house in Salto di Avegno, where she raised Maine Coon cats and treated them as family.
Former students and friends remember her fondly.
women.example: Her life shows how a teacher's care for children can grow into care for every living creature around her.

women.name: Nihal Kaddouri
tribute: Nihal Kaddouri, 28, was a mother of young children who came to Italy eight years ago. With her family she had recently made a new home in Brugine, in the province of Padua.
